scopeDefinition: Research the Python standard library with the web scraper. List all its libraries, the proposed provider binding with input and output contracts for each available library, and its five best use cases. Deliver a report.
evidenceStatement: A published Markdown design report covers every current Python standard library module and separately identifies all removed modules from the official pinned index. Each current module has a cited scraped documentation URL and response hash, a proposed operation and APIs, input and output JSON object contracts, failure modes, effects, constraints and five ranked use cases. These are design proposals. No provider installation, execution, external delivery or other action is evidenced.
